sentences.en: Deforestation and poor irrigation practices can lead to irreversible desertification.
sentences.zh: 1. 森林开伐和不良灌溉做法可能导致不可逆转的沙漠化。

sentences.en: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 2. 油棕榈生产是印度尼西亚森林开伐的主要原因。

sentences.en: Despite the efforts of environmentalists, the deforestation of the region continues.
sentences.zh: 3. 尽管环保人士的努力，该地区的森林开伐仍在继续。

phrases.zh: 1. 关于森林开伐的；由于森林开伐引起的

senses.zh: 开伐森林，砍掉（土地）上的树林
